questions.question: If a certain sum at compound interest becomes 3 times in 4 years, then in how many years will it become 9 times, at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If a certain sum at compound interest becomes 3 times in 4 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

**Calculation:**

Let the time be t

According to the question

We know that, 

Total Amount = P(1 + r/100)t

Now,

⇒ 3P = P(1 + r/100)⁴

⇒ 3 = (1 + r/100)⁴ ....(1)

Now,

After t years the sum becomes 9 times 

⇒ 9P = P(1 + r/100)t

⇒ 9 = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ 3² = (1 + r/100)t

Using equation (1), we get

⇒ (1 + r/100)⁸ = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ t = 8 years

**∴ The required time is 8 years**

questions.question: A train covers a distance of 275 km in 2 (1)/(2) hours with a uniform speed. The time taken to cover a distance of 440 km with the same speed is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 275 km

Time = 2 (1)/(2) hours = 5/2 hours

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ Speed = (275/5/2) 

⇒ (275 × 2)/5

⇒ 110 km/h

Now,

The time taken to cover a distance of 440 km with the same speed = (440/110) hours

⇒ 4 hours

**∴ The required time is 4 hours**

questions.question: The cost prices of two articles are in the ratio 4 : 5. While selling these articles. the shopkeeper gains 10% on one article and 20% profit on the other article, and the difference in the selling price is Rs. 480. Find the total cost price of both the articles.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of cost price of two articles = 4 : 5

SP on first articles = 10% gain

SP on second articles = 20% profit

The difference in the selling price = Rs. 480

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of two articles be 40x and 50x respectively.

According to the question

SP on first article = (110% of 40x)

⇒ (110/100 × 40x) = 44x

SP on second article = (120% of 50x)

⇒ (120/100 × 50x) = 60x

Now,

The difference in the selling price = Rs. 480

⇒ (60x – 44x) = 480

⇒ 16x = 480

⇒ x = 30

Now,

The total cost price of both the articles = Rs. (40 × 30 + 50 × 30)

⇒ Rs. (1,200 + 1,500)

⇒ Rs. 2,700

**∴ The total cost price of both the articles is Rs. 2,700**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 17,200 is lent out at simple interest in two parts for two years at 8% and 10% p.a., respectively. If the total interest received after two years is Rs. 3,008, then the money lent at 8% rate is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 17,200

Rate = 8% and 10%

The total interest received after two years = Rs. 3,008

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the amount lent on 8% be x.

Then, the amount lent on 10% be (17,200 – x)

So, Interest on first part = (x × 8 × 2)/100

And, Interest on second part = [(17,200 – x) × 10 × 2/100]

Now,

⇒ (x × 8 × 2)/100 + [(17,200 – x) × 10 × 2/100] = 3,008

⇒ 16x/100 + 344,000 – 20x/100 = 3,008

⇒ (16x + 344,000 – 20x) = 3,008 × 100

⇒ (16x + 344,000 – 20x) = 300,800

⇒ (20x – 16x) = (344,000 – 300,800)

⇒ 4x = 43,200

⇒ x = (43,200/4)

⇒ x = Rs. 10,800

Now,

The money lent on 8% = x = Rs. 10,800

**∴ The required money is Rs. 10,800**

questions.question: The radii of the circular ends of a frustum of a cone are 20 cm and 13 cm and its height is 12 cm. What is the capacity (in litres) of the frustum (correct to one decimal place)? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radii of the circular ends of a frustum of a cone = 20 cm and 13 cm

Height = 12 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b86141ce8528bbecfe394ac8e88d65be68cb8be8d220577b0fd3b63c094f09f0.png] 

Volume of frustum shaped cone = 1/3π(R² + r² +Rr)h

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Let R = 20 cm and r = 13 cm

Now,

Volume of frustum shaped cone = 1/3π(R2 + r2 +Rr)h

⇒ [1/3 × 22/7 × (20² + 13² + 20 × 13) × 12]

questions.question: The perimeter of rectangular field is 386 m and the difference between its two adjacent sides is 95 m. The side of a square field, having the same area as that of the rectangle. is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of rectangular field = 386 m

The difference between its two adjacent sides = 95 m

The side of a square field, having the same area as that of the rectangle

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(L + B)

Area of rectangle = L × B

Area of square = a²

**Calculation:**

Let the length of rectangle be L and breadth be B respectively.

According to the question

The perimeter of rectangular field = 386 m

⇒ 2(L + B) = 386

⇒ (L + B) = 193 ...(1)

The difference between its two adjacent sides = 95 m

⇒ (L – B) = 95 .....(2)

Adding equation (1) and (2), we get

⇒ (L + B) = 193 + (L – B) = 95

⇒ 2L = (193 + 95)

⇒ 2L = 288

⇒ L = 144 m

Now, putting the value of L in equation (1), we get

⇒ (L + B) = 193

⇒ (144 + B) = 193

⇒ B = (193 – 144)

⇒ B = 49 m

Now,

Area of square = Area of rectangle

⇒ a² = L × B

⇒ a² = (144 × 49) m

⇒ a² = 7056 m²

⇒ a = 84 m

**∴ The each side of the square is 84 m**

questions.question: If the mean of x + 1, x + 12, 2x + 3 and 3x + 5 is 21, then the value of x is:
questions.solution:

The mean of x + 1, x + 12, 2x + 3 and 3x + 5 = 21

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The mean of x + 1, x + 12, 2x + 3 and 3x + 5 = 21

Average = (7x + 21)/4 = 21

⇒ 7x + 21 = 84

⇒ 7x = (84 – 21) = 63

⇒ x = (63/7)

⇒ x = 9

**∴ The value of x is 9**

questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a cylinder is decreased by 40%

The height is increased by 60% to form a new cylinder.

**Concept used:**

If the radius is contested then the volume of the cylinder is directly proportional to height.

If the height is contested then the volume of the cylinder is directly proportional to radius.

**Formula used:**

volume of the cylinder = π × (radius)² × height

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of cylinder be r cm and height be h cm.

Then, volume of the cylinder is

⇒ π × (radius)2 × height

⇒ πr²h cm³

Now, increment in height = 60%

⇒ h × (160/100)

⇒ 8h/5 cm

Radius after decreasing 40%

⇒ r × (60/100)

⇒ 3r/5 cm

Now, the volume of the cylinder

⇒ π × (radius)² × height

⇒ π × (3r/5)² × (8h/5)

⇒ π × (9r²/25) × 8h/5

⇒ (72πr²h/125) cm³

Now, the difference between both volumes

⇒ (πr²h) – (72πr2h/125) cm³

⇒ (125πr²h – 72πr²h)/125 cm³

⇒ 53πr²h/125 cm³

Now,

The volume will be decreased by

⇒ [(53πr2h/125)/πr²h × 100]

⇒ (53/125 × 100)

⇒ 212/5

⇒ 42.4%

**∴ The volume will be decreased by 42.4%**

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. The sum of their squares is 2349. Find the average of these three numbers
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of three numbers = 2 : 3 : 4.

The sum of their squares = 2349

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let the three numbers be m, n and p respectively.

According to the question

m : n : p = 2 : 3 : 4

And, m² + n² + p² = 2349

Let m : n : p = k

Then, m = 2k, n = 3k and p = 4k

Now,

⇒ m2 + n2 + p2 = 2349

⇒ (2k)² + (3k)² + (4k)² = 2349

⇒ 4k² + 9k² + 16k² = 2349

⇒ 29k² = 2349

⇒ k² = (2349/29)

⇒ k² = 81

⇒ k = 9

Now, 

m = 2k = (2 × 9) = 18

n = 3k = (3 × 9) = 27

p = 4k = (4 × 9) = 36

Average of these three numbers = (18 + 27 + 36)/3

⇒ 81/3

⇒ 27

**∴ The average of these three numbers is 27**

questions.question: A is 120% of B and B is 65% of C. If the sum of A, B and C is 121 (1)/(2), then the value of 2C – 4B + A is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let C = 100 parts.

⇒ B = 65 parts and A = 120% of 65 = 78 parts.

⇒ Total Ratio = 78 + 65 + 100 = 243 parts.

⇒ Given Total = 121 1/2 = 243/2 ⇒ 1 part = 1/2.

⇒ Value to find = 2(100) − 4(65) + 78 = 200 − 260 + 78 = 18 parts.

⇒ Final Value = 18 × (1/2) = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A is 120% of B

B is 65% of C

Sum of A, B, and C = 121 1/2 = 243/2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e6f36454efe03312f672d8f8583012624892d08f4826c404ff018605d89b0bc.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the value of C = 100x

⇒ B = 65% of 100x = 65x

⇒ A = 120% of 65x = (120/100) × 65x = 78x

⇒ A + B + C = 78x + 65x + 100x = 243x

⇒ Given, 243x = 243/2

⇒ x = (243/2) ÷ 243 = 1/2

We need to find the value of 2C − 4B + A:

⇒ 2(100x) − 4(65x) + 78x

⇒ 200x − 260x + 78x = 18x

Substitute the value of x:

⇒ 18 × (1/2) = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Ratio Conversion

Converting percentages to ratios simplifies calculations immensely. Example: 120% = 120/100 = 6/5. If A is 120% of B, the immediate ratio of A:B becomes 6:5.

Base Assumption in Successive Percentages

When multiple variables are linked successively (e.g., A depends on B, and B depends on C), assuming the final independent variable (C) as 100 or 100x effectively eliminates complex decimals and fractions.

Compound Ratio Method

To combine A:B = m:n and B:C = p:q into A:B:C, you can equate the common term (B) by finding the LCM of n and p, or use the direct pattern (m×p) : (n×p) : (n×q).
</p

questions.question: Between two consecutive years, my income is in the ratio 2 : 5 and expenses are in the ratio 4 : 7. If my income in the second year is Rs. 75,000 and my expenses in the first year are Rs. 20,000, then my total savings in the two years together are:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income ratio for Year 1 and Year 2 is 2 : 5.

Since Year 2 income is Rs. 75,000 (5 parts), Year 1 income (2 parts) = (75,000 ÷ 5) × 2 = Rs. 30,000.

Expense ratio for Year 1 and Year 2 is 4 : 7.

Since Year 1 expense is Rs. 20,000 (4 parts), Year 2 expense (7 parts) = (20,000 ÷ 4) × 7 = Rs. 35,000.

Total Savings = (Income₁ − Expense₁) + (Income₂ − Expense₂) = (30,000 − 20,000) + (75,000 − 35,000) = 10,000 + 40,000 = Rs. 50,000.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 50,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Income (Year 1 : Year 2) = 2 : 5

Ratio of Expenses (Year 1 : Year 2) = 4 : 7

Income in Year 2 = Rs. 75,000

Expenses in Year 1 = Rs. 20,000

**Formula Used:**

Savings = Income − Expenses

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Income in Year 1 and Year 2 be 2x and 5x respectively.

⇒ Income in Year 2 = 5x = 75,000

⇒ x = 75,000 ÷ 5 = 15,000

⇒ Income in Year 1 = 2x = 2 × 15,000 = Rs. 30,000

⇒ Let Expenses in Year 1 and Year 2 be 4y and 7y respectively.

⇒ Expense in Year 1 = 4y = 20,000

⇒ y = 20,000 ÷ 4 = 5,000

⇒ Expense in Year 2 = 7y = 7 × 5,000 = Rs. 35,000

⇒ Savings in Year 1 = Income in Year 1 − Expenses in Year 1

⇒ Savings in Year 1 = 30,000 − 20,000 = Rs. 10,000

⇒ Savings in Year 2 = Income in Year 2 − Expenses in Year 2

⇒ Savings in Year 2 = 75,000 − 35,000 = Rs. 40,000

⇒ Total Savings = Savings in Year 1 + Savings in Year 2

⇒ Total Savings = 10,000 + 40,000 = Rs. 50,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 50,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure & Savings

The core formula for all personal finance word problems is: Income = Expenditure + Savings. If any two parameters are given or derived, the third can be computed easily.

Proportional Scaling

When values are given in a specific ratio a : b, finding the exact multiplier (the value of 1 ratio part) from a single known quantity allows direct calculation of the remaining unknowns without requiring complex equations.

Independent Ratios

Income ratios and expenditure ratios operate entirely independent of one another. You cannot directly combine, add, or subtract ratio parts of income with ratio parts of expenses; they must be evaluated to their actual numerical values first.
</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold 25 articles in such a way that he gets a profit which is equal to the selling price of 5 articles. Find his profit percent?
questions.solution:

By selling 25 articles there is a porfit equal to SP of 5 articles

Profit = SP – CP

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price be x

25 articles sold at = Rs. 25x

Now,

The profit which is equal to the selling price of 5 articles = 5x

CP = SP – Profit

⇒ (25x – 5x) = 20x

Now,

⇒ (1/4 × 100)%

⇒ 25%

**∴ The required profit percent is 25%**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 60 days. He works at it for 15 days, and then B alone finishes the remaining work in 30 days. In how many days can A and B working together finish the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work = 60 days

Number of days A works = 15 days

B alone finish the remaining work = 30 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = (60/15) = 4 days

Number of days B works = (1 – 1/4) = 3/4 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = (4/3 × 30) = 40 days

Now,

LCM of 60 and 40 is 120

Efficiency of A = (120/60) = 2 units/day

⇒ (90/130 × 100)

⇒ (9000/130)

⇒ 69.23%
